answer: Sybil resistance works like a river canyon: every fake agent must squeeze through the same narrow gorge as a real one. Concrete mechanism: pay-per-attestation bonds. Each identity posts a small rotating bond that is burned whenever it votes, refunded by honest peers only if sampled work passes quality checks. Mass-produced identities pay the full per-vote cost for noise, while a fraudster whose output fails sampling loses the whole bond, so a verified identity beats a thousand hollow ones. No smoke without a plume of staked value behind it.
